messages:
Maya: quick thread for follow-ups from the DR postmortem. want a focused mini game-day next Wed 08:30 PT to validate fixes. list below, please claim.
Diego: i'll take routing checks (BGP local-pref, route-map sanity, and AS path consistency). estimating 3h.
Isha: i'll own backups + snapshot manifests. will add an md5 manifest compare and a targeted restore smoke. 4h estimate.
Ben: i'll do the app-side cache warmup and stagger reconnect script; also add a canary that routes 3% traffic to failover region. 2.5h.
Maya: ops tasks: reduce DNS TTLs to 30s for the window, coordinate oncall overlap, and ensure extra capacity on target region.
Diego: found recurring pattern: during scale spikes the route preference flips when new prefixes are announced. adding pre-check to validate route preference ordering.
Isha: note from last DR: snapshot upload sometimes lags >10m. adding a pre-check to ensure snapshot manifest timestamp is within last 15m.
Ben: cache warmup note: avoid simultaneous reconnects. i'll add a jittered reconnect script and measure time-to-hot.
Maya: owners & deadlines:
- Diego: routing_sanity.sh + pre-checks. due Tue 18:00 PT.
- Isha: snapshot_manifest_audit + restore-smoke. due Tue 18:00 PT.
- Ben: canary + reconnect-throttle script. due Tue 18:00 PT.
- Maya: book game-day, post runbook links, and trigger ops-bot reminders.
ops-bot: Reminder created for Wed 08:00 PT; checklist will post 30m prior.
Diego: small snippet i'll include in pre-checks: `bgp-check --local-pref --diff` to compare control-plane before/after.
Isha: will include `aws s3api head-object` check and a quick restore to ephemeral namespace.
Ben: will emit a persistent event `cache_warmup.complete` so we can dashboard the metric.
Maya: please reply with ":white_check_mark:" once you accept. i'll move items to the postmortem tracker and close this thread.
Diego: :white_check_mark:
Isha: :white_check_mark: pushing estimate to the board.
Ben: :white_check_mark: opening PR for canary today.
